const gen = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
import difflib, json, pathlib, re, sys
root = pathlib.Path('.')
task = root / '.ai/task/repair-w62-20261001'
workset = json.loads((task / 'WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
claims = json.loads((task / 'SOURCE-CLAIMS.json').read_text())
by_file = {}
for item in workset:
    ident = item['entry_revision_identity']
    claim = claims[ident]
    m = re.search(r'修复：整条 target“(.*?)”→“(.*?)”[。.]?$', claim, re.S)
    if not m:
        raise SystemExit(f'cannot parse claim {ident}')
    old, new = m.groups()
    if old != item['target_preimage']:
        raise SystemExit(f'preimage mismatch {ident}')
    by_file.setdefault(item['normalized_path'], []).append((item, old, new))
patch = ['*** Begin Patch']
replaced = 0
for filename in sorted(by_file):
    path = root / filename
    original = path.read_text()
    lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
    modified = lines[:]
    for item, old, new in by_file[filename]:
        marker = f'section "{item["section"]}"'
        starts = [i for i, line in enumerate(modified) if line.rstrip('\n') == marker]
        if len(starts) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'section count {len(starts)} for {item["entry_revision_identity"]}: {marker}')
        start = starts[0] + 1
        end = next((i for i in range(start, len(modified)) if modified[i].startswith('section "')), len(modified))
        source_q = json.dumps(item['source'], ensure_ascii=False)
        old_q = json.dumps(old, ensure_ascii=False)
        tag_q = json.dumps(item['source_tag'], ensure_ascii=False)
        needle = f't({source_q}, {old_q}, {tag_q})'
        hits = [i for i in range(start, end) if modified[i].rstrip('\n') == needle]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f'entry count {len(hits)} for {item["entry_revision_identity"]}: {needle}')
        idx = hits[0]
        newline = '\n' if modified[idx].endswith('\n') else ''
        modified[idx] = f't({source_q}, {json.dumps(new, ensure_ascii=False)}, {tag_q}){newline}'
        replaced += 1
    diff = list(difflib.unified_diff(lines, modified, fromfile=filename, tofile=filename, n=3))
    if not diff:
        raise SystemExit(f'no diff for {filename}')
    patch.append(f'*** Update File: {filename}')
    patch.extend(line.rstrip('\n') for line in diff[2:])
if replaced != 53:
    raise SystemExit(f'replaced {replaced}, expected 53')
patch.append('*** End Patch')
print('\n'.join(patch))
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":30000});
if (gen.exit_code !== 0) { text(gen.output); exit(); }
const applied = await tools.apply_patch(gen.output);
text(applied);

local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"}
local baseline = ".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001/baseline/"
local function load_catalog(path)
  local events, current = {}, nil
  local env = {}
  env.section = function(name)
    current = name
    events[#events + 1] = {kind = "section", name = name}
  end
  env.t = function(...)
    local args = {n = select("#", ...), ...}
    events[#events + 1] = {kind = "t", section = current, args = args}
  end
  setmetatable(env, {__index = _G})
  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
  assert(chunk, err)
  setfenv(chunk, env)
  local ok, runerr = pcall(chunk)
  assert(ok, path .. ": " .. tostring(runerr))
  return events
end
local changed = 0
for _, file in ipairs(files) do
  local before = load_catalog(baseline .. file)
  local after = load_catalog(file)
  assert(#before == #after, file .. ": record count changed")
  for i = 1, #before do
    local a, b = before[i], after[i]
    assert(a.kind == b.kind, file .. ": record kind changed at " .. i)
    if a.kind == "section" then
      assert(a.name == b.name, file .. ": section changed at " .. i)
    else
      assert(a.section == b.section, file .. ": section association changed at " .. i)
      assert(a.args.n == b.args.n, file .. ": arg count changed at " .. i)
      local target_only = false
      for j = 1, a.args.n do
        if a.args[j] ~= b.args[j] then
          assert(j == 2 and not target_only, file .. ": non-target or multiple field change at " .. i)
          target_only = true
        end
      end
      if target_only then
        local fields = {file, a.section, a.args[1], a.args[2], b.args[2], a.args[3], tostring(a.args.n)}
        for _, value in ipairs(fields) do
          assert(type(value) == "string" and not value:find("[\\t\\r\\n]"), file .. ": unsafe validation field")
        end
        io.write("CHANGE\\t", table.concat(fields, "\\t"), "\\n")
        changed = changed + 1
      end
    end
  end
end
io.write("LUA_SUMMARY\\t", tostring(#files), "\\t", tostring(changed), "\\n")

env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"}
local baseline = ".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001/baseline/"
local function deep_equal(a, b, seen)
  if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
  if type(a) ~= "table" then return a == b end
  seen = seen or {}
  if seen[a] == b then return true end
  seen[a] = b
  for k, v in pairs(a) do if not deep_equal(v, b[k], seen) then return false end end
  for k in pairs(b) do if a[k] == nil then return false end end
  return true
end
local function load_catalog(path)
  local events, current = {}, nil
  local env = {}
  env.section = function(name)
    current = name
    events[#events + 1] = {kind = "section", name = name}
  end
  env.t = function(...)
    events[#events + 1] = {kind = "t", section = current, args = {n = select("#", ...), ...}}
  end
  setmetatable(env, {__index = _G})
  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
  assert(chunk, err)
  setfenv(chunk, env)
  local ok, runerr = pcall(chunk)
  assert(ok, path .. ": " .. tostring(runerr))
  return events
end
local changed = 0
for _, file in ipairs(files) do
  local before = load_catalog(baseline .. file)
  local after = load_catalog(file)
  assert(#before == #after, file .. ": record count changed")
  for i = 1, #before do
    local a, b = before[i], after[i]
    assert(a.kind == b.kind, file .. ": record kind changed at " .. i)
    if a.kind == "section" then
      assert(a.name == b.name, file .. ": section changed at " .. i)
    else
      assert(a.section == b.section, file .. ": section association changed at " .. i)
      assert(a.args.n == b.args.n, file .. ": arg count changed at " .. i)
      local target_only = false
      for j = 1, a.args.n do
        if not deep_equal(a.args[j], b.args[j]) then
          assert(j == 2 and not target_only, file .. ": non-target or multiple field change at " .. i)
          target_only = true
        end
      end
      if target_only then
        local fields = {file, a.section, a.args[1], a.args[2], b.args[2], a.args[3], tostring(a.args.n)}
        for _, value in ipairs(fields) do assert(type(value) == "string", file .. ": non-string validation field") end
        io.write("CHANGE\\t", table.concat(fields, "\\t"), "\\n")
        changed = changed + 1
      end
    end
  end
end
io.write("LUA_SUMMARY\\t", tostring(#files), "\\t", tostring(changed), "\\n")

import json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
task = Path(".ai/task/repair-w62-20261001")
items = json.loads((task / "WORKSET.json").read_text())["items"]
claims = json.loads((task / "SOURCE-CLAIMS.json").read_text())
expected = {}
for item in items:
    ident = item["entry_revision_identity"]
    match = re.search(r"修复：整条 target“(.*?)”→“(.*?)”[。.]?$", claims[ident], re.S)
    assert match and match.group(1) == item["target_preimage"], ident
    key = (item["normalized_path"], item["section"], item["source"], item["source_tag"])
    assert key not in expected, key
    expected[key] = (match.group(1), match.group(2), item["args_order"])
actual = {}
summary = None
for raw in sys.stdin:
    parts = raw.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    if parts[0] == "CHANGE":
        assert len(parts) == 8, parts
        _, file, section, source, old, new, tag, argc = parts
        key = (file, section, source, tag)
        assert key not in actual, key
        actual[key] = (old, new, argc)
    elif parts[0] == "LUA_SUMMARY":
        summary = (int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]))
    else:
        raise AssertionError(parts)
assert summary == (4, 53), summary
assert set(actual) == set(expected), (set(expected) - set(actual), set(actual) - set(expected))
for key, (old, new, args_order) in expected.items():
    got_old, got_new, argc = actual[key]
    assert (got_old, got_new) == (old, new), key
    assert args_order is None and argc == "3", key
print("PASS: LuaJIT loaded 4 current + 4 baseline catalogs")
print("PASS: exactly 53 target-only record changes")
print("PASS: all 53 targets equal SOURCE-CLAIMS; source/section/source_tag/args and every other record are unchanged")
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
